description: One card on one role's dashboard, and where it sits. A row here is a POINTER: the card itself is a CRM Dashboard Chart and everything it means lives there, so a card corrected once is corrected on every dashboard that places it. The grid is 12 columns wide; x is the column it starts at, w how many it spans, and y/h the same downward in rows of 60px. A chart tile must be at least h=6, because the chart renderer will not draw below 300px and a shorter tile clips it.

fields.description: The card to place. It must already exist as a CRM Dashboard Chart.
fields.label: Card

fields.description: Row it starts at, counting from the top.
fields.label: Y

fields.description: How many of the 12 columns it spans.
fields.label: Width

fields.description: How many 60px rows tall. A chart needs at least 6; a number card is fine at 2.
fields.label: Height
